## Load Libraries + Data

```{r,message = F, warning=F}
set.seed(1234)
library(scran)
library(scuttle)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(Matrix)
library(ggpubr)
library(SpaTM)

gtm_phi <- readRDS("./Manuscript/log_filter_raw_final_phi_output.rds")
```

## Apply to LS

```{r}
rm_samples <- '/home/adrien/Desktop/LS_GTM/meta/remove_samples.txt'
meta_df <- '/home/adrien/Desktop/LS_GTM/meta/patient_meta.csv'
ls_meta <- '/home/adrien/Desktop/LS_GTM/meta/LS_Meta.csv'

meta_df <- read.csv(meta_df,header = T,na.strings = "N/A")
rownames(meta_df) <- meta_df$Patient
ls_meta <- read.csv(ls_meta, header = T,na.strings = "N/A")

rm_samples <- colnames(read.csv(rm_samples))
meta_df <- meta_df[!rownames(meta_df) %in% rm_samples,]
meta_df$Cond <- NA
meta_df$Cond[str_detect(rownames(meta_df),"CSU")] <- 'CSU'
meta_df$Cond[str_detect(rownames(meta_df),"LS")] <- 'LS'
meta_df$Cond[str_detect(rownames(meta_df),"N")] <- 'CTRL'
meta_df$Cond[str_detect(rownames(meta_df),"CTRL")] <- 'CTRL'
rownames(meta_df) <- str_replace(rownames(meta_df),"\\.","-")

meta_df$GCL <- NA
meta_df$GCL[match(ls_meta$Sample.Name,rownames(meta_df))] <- ls_meta$Subtype..HC..Generalized..Circumscribed..Linear.
meta_df$GCL[meta_df$Cond == 'CTRL'] <- 'Healthy'
meta_df$Activity <- NA
meta_df$Activity[match(ls_meta$Sample.Name,rownames(meta_df))] <- ls_meta$Activity..Healthy..Inactive..Active.
meta_df$Activity[meta_df$Cond == 'CTRL'] <- 'Healthy'
meta_df$Group <- NA
meta_df$Group[match(ls_meta$Sample.Name,rownames(meta_df))] <- ls_meta$Group..Fibrotic.Inflammatory.
meta_df$Group[meta_df$Cond == 'CTRL'] <- 'Healthy'
meta_df$Cond[meta_df$Cond == 'CTRL'] <- 'Healthy'


meta_df <- meta_df[meta_df$Cond != 'CSU',]




meta_df <- meta_df %>%
  dplyr::select(-Patient) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Cond = factor(Cond,levels = c('Healthy','LS')),
                Activity = factor(Activity,levels = c('Healthy','Inactive','Active')),
                Group  = factor(Group,levels = c('Healthy','Inflammatory','I/F','Fibrotic')),
                GCL = factor(GCL, levels = c('Healthy','Generalized','Circumscribed','Linear')))
```

```{r}
#Summarized Experiment
bulk_counts <- read.csv("./Data/final_counts.csv")
rownames(bulk_counts) <- bulk_counts$Gene
bulk_counts <- bulk_counts[,-1]
bulk_counts <- as.matrix(bulk_counts)
colnames(bulk_counts) <- str_replace(colnames(bulk_counts),'\\.','-')
library(Matrix)
bulk_counts <- as(bulk_counts,'dgCMatrix')

bulk_counts <- bulk_counts[,rownames(meta_df)]
se <- SingleCellExperiment(assays = list(counts = bulk_counts),
                           colData = meta_df)

keep.genes <- intersect(rownames(gtm_phi),rownames(se))
se <- se[keep.genes,]
gtm_phi <- gtm_phi[keep.genes,]
```

```{r}
K <- ncol(gtm_phi)
se <- SingleCellTopicExperiment(se,K = K)


se <- inferTopics(se,6,150,T,gtm_phi)

se <- buildTheta(se)

colnames(theta(se)) <- colnames(gtm_phi)

saveRDS(theta(se),"./Manuscript/DESeq2/LS_decon.rds")
```

```{r}
library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)
decon <- cbind(as.data.frame(theta(se)),
               meta_df)
cell_names <- colnames(decon)[1:20]
```

```{r}
all_data <- list()
all_data[['Group']]  <- decon %>%  dplyr::select(-GCL, -Age, -Sex, -Cond, -Activity)
all_data[['Activity']] <- decon %>%  dplyr::select(-GCL, -Age, -Sex, -Cond, -Group)
all_data[['Cond']]  <- decon %>%  dplyr::select(-GCL, -Age, -Sex, -Activity, -Group)
all_data[['GCL']]   <- decon %>%  dplyr::select(-Cond, -Age, -Sex, -Activity, -Group)
# Iterate over unique variables
unique_vars <-cell_names
all_plots <- list()


ls_compare <- list(
                  Group = list( c("Healthy", "Inflammatory"),
                                c("Healthy", "Fibrotic"),
                                c("Inflammatory", "Fibrotic")),
                  Activity = list(c('Healthy','Active')),
                  Cond = list(c('Healthy','LS')),
                  GCL = list(c('Healthy','Generalized'),
                             c('Healthy','Circumscribed'),
                             c('Generalized','Circumscribed')))


ls_color <- list(
  Group  = c("#00AFBB", "#E7B800", "#FC4E07","#C26EFF"),
  Activity = c("#00AFBB", "#69D045", "#6A0572"),
  Cond = c("#00AFBB",'#E63946'),
  GCL = c("#00AFBB",'#D3D3D3','#808080','#404040'))


for (id_var in names(all_data)){
  data <- all_data[[id_var]]
  data_long <- melt(data, id.vars = id_var) %>% na.omit()
  cur_plots <- list()
  for (var in unique_vars){
    plot_data <- data_long %>%  
      dplyr::filter(variable == var)
  
    cur_plots[[var]] <- ggboxplot(plot_data,
            x = id_var, y = "value",
            fill = id_var,
            palette = ls_color[[id_var]],
            add = "jitter") + 
    stat_compare_means(comparisons = ls_compare[[id_var]],
                       method = "wilcox.test",
                        p.adjust.method = "BH",
                       bracket_size = 0.25,
                         size = 6) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 25) +
        theme(
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.title.x = element_blank(),  
          plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          axis.line = element_line(size = 1),  # Thicker axis lines
          axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1)
        ) +
        labs(
          #title = str_to_title(var),
          x = id_var,
          y = "Proportion"
        )
                    
  }
  all_plots[[id_var]] <- cur_plots
}
```

```{r,echo = FALSE}

for (var in unique_vars){
```

```{r}
# Create a data frame of all statistical test results
all_test_results <- list()

for (id_var in names(all_data)) {
  data <- all_data[[id_var]]
  data_long <- melt(data, id.vars = id_var) %>% na.omit()
  
  for (var in unique_vars) {
    plot_data <- data_long %>%  
      dplyr::filter(variable == var)
    
    # Filter out unwanted levels
    if (id_var == "Group") {
      plot_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Group != "I/F")
    }
    if (id_var == "GCL") {
      plot_data <- plot_data %>% filter(GCL != "Linear")
    }
    if (id_var == "Activity") {
      plot_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Activity != "Inactive")
    }
    
    # Create formula for compare_means
    formula <- as.formula(paste("value ~", id_var))
    
    # Run statistical tests
    test_results <- compare_means(
      formula = formula,
      data = plot_data,
      method = "wilcox.test",
      p.adjust.method = "BH",
      comparisons = ls_compare[[id_var]]
    )
    
    # Add metadata
    test_results$CellType <- var
    test_results$Factor <- id_var
    
    # Add to results list
    all_test_results[[paste(id_var, var, sep = "_")]] <- test_results
  }
}

# Combine all results into one data frame
final_test_results <- do.call(rbind, all_test_results)

```

```{r}
# Create a data frame of all statistical test results with group means
all_test_results <- list()

for (id_var in names(all_data)) {
  data <- all_data[[id_var]]
  data_long <- melt(data, id.vars = id_var) %>% na.omit()

  
  for (var in unique_vars) {
    plot_data <- data_long %>%  
      dplyr::filter(variable == var)
    
    # Filter out unwanted levels
    if (id_var == "Group") {
      plot_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Group != "I/F")
    }
    if (id_var == "GCL") {
      plot_data <- plot_data %>% filter(GCL != "Linear")
    }
    if (id_var == "Activity") {
      plot_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Activity != "Inactive")
    }
    
    # Calculate means for each group
    group_means <- plot_data %>%
      group_by(!!sym(id_var)) %>%
      summarize(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
                n = n())
    
    # Create formula for compare_means
    formula <- as.formula(paste("value ~", id_var))
    
    # Run statistical tests
    test_results <- compare_means(
      formula = formula,
      data = plot_data,
      method = "wilcox.test",
      p.adjust.method = "BH",
      comparisons = ls_compare[[id_var]]
    )
    
    # Add means to test results
    test_results <- test_results %>%
      mutate(
        group1_mean = sapply(group1, function(g) {
          group_means$mean_value[group_means[[id_var]] == g]
        }),
        group2_mean = sapply(group2, function(g) {
          group_means$mean_value[group_means[[id_var]] == g]
        })
      )
    
    # Add metadata
    test_results$CellType <- var
    test_results$Factor <- id_var
    
    # Add to results list
    all_test_results[[paste(id_var, var, sep = "_")]] <- test_results

  }
  
}

# Combine all results into one data frame
final_test_results <- do.call(rbind, all_test_results)

```

```{r}
all_plots <- list()

for (id_var in names(all_data)) {
  cur_plots <- list()
  for (var in unique_vars) {
    # Use the full data for plotting, omitting NA values
    plot_data <- melt(all_data[[id_var]], id.vars = id_var) %>% 
      filter(variable == var) %>% na.omit()
    
    # For computing annotation positions, use a filtered version (unwanted groups omitted)
    stat_data <- plot_data
    if (id_var == "Group") {
      stat_data <- stat_data %>% filter(Group != "I/F")
    }
    if (id_var == "GCL") {
      stat_data <- stat_data %>% filter(GCL != "Linear")
    }
    if (id_var == "Activity") {
      stat_data <- stat_data %>% filter(Activity != "Inactive")
    }
    
    # Subset the pre-computed test results for this factor and cell type
    stat_subset <- final_test_results %>% 
      filter(CellType == var, Factor == id_var)
    
    # Set annotation y.position using full (plot_data) values (omit NAs)
    base_y <- max(plot_data$value, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05
    stat_subset <- stat_subset %>%
      arrange(p.adj) %>%
      mutate(y.position = base_y + (row_number()-1) * 0.1 * base_y)  # increased vertical space
    
    # Create the box plot with jitter and p-value annotations
    p <- ggboxplot(plot_data,
                   x = id_var, 
                   y = "value",
                   fill = id_var,
                   palette = ls_color[[id_var]],
                   add = "jitter") +
         stat_pvalue_manual(stat_subset,
                            label = "p.adj",
                            xmin = "group1",
                            xmax = "group2",
                            y.position = "y.position",
                            tip.length = 0.01,
                            bracket.size = 0.5,
                            size = 6,
                            step.increase = 0.005) +
         theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
         theme(
           axis.text.x = element_blank(),
           axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
           axis.title.x = element_blank(),
           plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
           axis.line = element_line(size = 1),
           axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1)
         ) +
         labs(
           #title = str_to_title(var),
           x = id_var,
           y = "Proportion"
         )
    
    cur_plots[[var]] <- p
  }
  all_plots[[id_var]] <- cur_plots
}
```
